verdict.rationale: Rev AI's only event-related capability is a webhook notification when a transcription job completes. That is a developer building block a user could wire into their own automation, not a product feature for defining rules that trigger actions on events. Nothing in the evidence shows a rules engine, conditional triggers, or configurable automated actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: use webhooks to asynchronously receive notifications once the transcription job completes.
